name: Specialty Wood Manufacturing
old_description: Custom commercial millwork and fixtures built with old-world craftsmanship and modern-day technology. Established 1975.
about:
Specialty Wood Manufacturing has operated from Tacoma, Washington since its founding in 1975. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces custom commercial millwork and fixtures, offering fabrication, design, and installation services from a 53,000-square-foot facility. Its capabilities span custom cabinets, casework, tabletops, commercial kitchen counters, bars, booths, divider walls, and trim. The shop works with hardwoods, exotic woods, granite, marble, veneers, laminates, glass, quartz, and stainless steel, and can fully assemble and disassemble projects before shipment.

Specialty Wood Manufacturing serves architects, designers, engineers, and contractors on commercial projects. Its portfolio includes fixtures for bars, restaurants, and other hospitality venues, as well as retail and institutional spaces.

The firm emphasizes a blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern technology, with an in-house design team that applies value engineering to meet budget and aesthetic goals. It also provides nationwide installation, positioning itself as a single-source partner from concept to completion.
